author: Kevin Kelly
short: Owner controls, private update URLs and daily repo/cog updates with slash sync.
description: Independently installable presentation layer beside bundled Red Downloader. Themes native replies and supplies checked /download controls for repositories, installation, updates, pinning and revision selection. Keeps the native installation agreement, converters, disabled-command state, dependency reports and reload behavior. Does not replace Downloader or create another package database. Optional signed GitHub pushes to an installed repository’s tracked branch coalesce updates of every repository and unpinned installed cog, with native dependency checks and automatic reloads. The private listener is owner configured; no webhook payloads are retained. Owner-only !updateall and /updateall refresh every repository, update all unpinned installed cogs and reload changed loaded packages without webhook setup. Private browser links or authenticated POST requests can queue the same update. Optional daily updates use a persistent timezone-aware schedule (default 04:00 America/Chicago). Updateall, URL/GitHub triggers and daily runs sync enabled application commands after reload, deduplicating unchanged definitions and preserving Red enable choices.
install_msg: Load bundled Downloader, then [p]load downloaderplus. Use [p]updateall to update every repo and unpinned cog, reload changes and sync enabled slash commands, or [p]download help; enable slash commands with [p]slash enablecog downloaderplus and [p]slash sync. Existing repo/cog commands remain available. Guide: https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs/blob/main/downloaderplus/README.md
end_user_data_statement: DownloaderPlus optionally stores a private webhook secret, listener settings, the configuring bot owner's ID and notification channel, up to 256 delivery IDs/body digests, a pending-update flag and the latest update status. A private trigger credential is derived from the secret. Optional daily updates store the time, timezone, configuring owner/channel IDs, schedule generation, next-run timestamp and latest result. Slash sync stores a command-schema fingerprint and two timestamps to avoid redundant uploads. It stores no webhook payloads or new repository copies. It delegates to bundled Red Downloader, whose existing repository, installed-cog and data policies continue to apply. Results are sent to the invoking Discord channel or configured automation result channel. Owner IDs and channel settings are included in that owner's data export; secrets and replay digests are excluded. Deleting that owner's data disables and clears their webhook and daily schedule, without erasing another owner's automation.
